source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: As each Fight phase begins, in either player's turn, pick one enemy unit in Engagement Range of the unit this model is part of and roll a D6, raising the score by one for each full group of five models that this model's own unit contains. A 2-3 inflicts D3 mortal wounds on the picked unit, a 4-5 inflicts 3, and a 6+ inflicts D3+3.
